card.name: Partway through split words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a word that is split up, most clearly the 'O' inside EMBRYO-FETAL in boxed warning headings. It also fires on pieces of URLs and 'vials'.

modes.label: Embryo-fetal warning heading
modes.description: The 'O' piece in the capitalised heading EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.

modes.label: Other split pieces
modes.description: A short piece in the middle of a split word such as 'vials' or a web address.
